title: Aluminum tree with a mid-century look
text: Aluminum tree with a mid-century look. I have my Grandmother's 1950's authentic Pom-Pom 7' aluminum tree, but this year decoded to go with a smaller tree. This is the 4.5 - 5 foot tree and it's gorgeous! Very sturdy, easy to put together ant it matches my mid-century décor perfectly! I would recommend to anyone that wants that vintage look in a tree, but doesn't want to spend hundreds to thousands of dollars on one!

product_metadata.title: Vickerman 4.5' Silver Tinsel Fir Slim Artificial Christmas Tree, Unlit - Faux Silver Christmas Tree - Seasonal Indoor Home Decor
features: Unlit tree - this tree comes unlit and ready to have your favorite lights added.
Complement your holiday decor with a long lasting Silver Tinsel Fir christmas tree.
Easy assembly - Includes a metal tree stand and metal hinged branches.
Add a welcome feeling to any space in your home with the addition of this decorative faux tree.
description: Vickerman 4.5' x 24" Silver Tinsel Fir Slim Artificial Christmas Tree featuring 400 PVC Tips. An elegant alternative to the traditional green Christmas tree, this brilliant tree comes unlit, has rich colored PVC tips on metal hinged branches, and a metal tree stand is included. For additional complimentary accents see the many wreaths and garlands available from Vickerman. This durable tree is maintenance free and will suit any decor. Vickerman has been an industry leader since 1940. Enjoy this expert designed seasonal tree around your home.
